action: Prepare but do not submit: ask Okinawa Defense Bureau information desk which FY2024 existing file, holder, request count and copy method fit the target.

output_to_save: date/time/contact; exact file title; holding division; count; fee/stamp instruction

does_not_complete: Not a formal disclosure request or a visibility result.

action: Submit one narrowed WHS request after requester/fee fields are truthfully completed.

why_this_is_minimal: One award, a known recipient and a bounded record family test the national-to-local allocation gap without asking for a new calculation.
does_not_complete: Does not establish Okinawa allocation or release W2-F.

action: Submit one narrowed MCIPAC request for one installation-level FY statement after live route is confirmed.

output_to_save: route screenshot; submitted text; case number; fee/referral correspondence
why_this_is_minimal: Tests who actually holds the local account layer before requesting a five-year financial archive.
does_not_complete: Does not establish funding source, subsidy, or a complete MCCS balance sheet.

action: After step 0, file one paper/counter request with the exact FY2024 file title and stated stamp amount.
